main.description: Who can access this space, in every space under the group. Grants apply only to this space. Members whose roles grant read may obtain space credentials and write their own records here. The group authority issues space credentials according to this record and nothing else.

public.description: Anyone signed in can read, member or not.

grants.description: At most one entry per role.

writableBy.description: Who may write into the space in their own name, when not every member whose roles grant read: role ids, or 'public' for anyone signed in.

people.description: A space for chosen people: those who read it and write in it in their own name while they are members, beside the roles granted read, who read it.
